KEY TECHNICAL LEARNINGS (durable):
- E4 mechanism: tests/_extra_guard.py (via tests/conftest.py) converts importorskip self-skips (ui/reviewbot/pricing) into HARD ERRORS when REBAR_REQUIRE_EXTRAS=1. _build-and-test.yml sets it =1 AND installs --extra dev/reviewbot/ui; S5 sweep cells install FEWER extras, so they MUST leave REBAR_REQUIRE_EXTRAS unset. Verified code already does; S5 plan-review BLOCK on E4 was a plan-doc gap, remediated by description note + AC (not a code defect).
- Plan-review admits only descriptions <= 8000 chars (verify.max_ticket_description_chars). rebar counts ~40 chars fewer than wc -c; target wc -c <= ~8040.
- Stale-material close gate: closing an epic re-checks plan-review attestation currency; adding children (1->3) changed the fingerprint -> close failed 'stale-material'. Fix: re-run rebar review-plan <epic>, then retry close. Ticking AC checkboxes is attestation-SAFE (box state normalized out of fingerprint).
- Completion-verifier close needs a commit carrying the rebar-ticket: trailer reachable from worktree HEAD (satisfied by local commit even pre-merge).
- CLI quirks: 'rebar comment <id> "body"' is POSITIONAL; 'rebar session-log start' takes NO positional args (metadata only, then append); 'rebar verify-commit-ticket --rev HEAD'; prefix env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" on every command (worktree venv not on ambient PATH).
